cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says e-procurement runs end to end or is required of all public bodies.
cells.note: Rebuild, raised from 2: the government's March 2026 note says Central State Administration procedures run through the official e-procurement portal, in place since 2020 (CPV-001, dated to the note), and a new platform was awarded to extend it (CPV-002). Nothing found says it is required of all bodies.
